properties.name: handyai.jwt.secret
properties.description: Key that signs login tokens. At least 32 characters; set HANDYAI_JWT_SECRET in production.

properties.name: handyai.jwt.ttl-minutes
properties.description: How long a login token stays valid, in minutes.

properties.name: handyai.admin.email
properties.description: Email of the one admin account. Any other account holding the admin role is demoted on start.

properties.name: handyai.admin.password
properties.description: Password of the admin account. Never commit it: use HANDYAI_ADMIN_PASSWORD or the git-ignored config/application.properties. Blank means no admin account is created.

properties.name: handyai.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma separated origins allowed to call the API, e.g. the Vercel domain.

properties.name: handyai.seed.demo-user
properties.description: Create the demo account demo@handyai.app on start. Off in the prod profile.
